method: first measured epoch + 99 * median of non-first-process epochs; includes train, test and checkpoint
limitations: The epoch sum excludes dependency installation, dataset preparation/loading and final report export.
The projection is distinct from measured duration and requires comparable laptop/backend/data loading conditions.
Only completed epochs are observed; future epochs, LR transitions not yet reached, thermal drift and changing background load can alter the projected duration.
interpretation: Only completed epochs have measured durations. The 100-epoch estimate is a projection for a fresh run under comparable conditions, not measured or remaining time.
